subject: science

covers: Know that plants need energy from light to grow, and that plants reproduce.
Observe how seeds are spread in different ways.
Investigate how seeds need water and warmth, but not light, to germinate.
Know that insects pollinate some flowers.
Observe that flowers have male and female parts, and that seeds form when pollen fertilises the ovum.
Recognise the flowering plant life cycle: pollination, fertilisation, seed production, seed dispersal and germination.
